name: Farminerals Geochemical Soil Chromatography & Agronomic Terroir Materiality
description: Agronomic visual architecture derived from geochemical soil remineralization and volcanic geology. Employs the scientific Munsell Soil Color system (humus loam, terracotta silt, basalt, calcified chalk), pulverized mineral micro-texture, and laboratory Certificate of Analysis (CoA) batch telemetry.
designPhilosophy: Grounded in agronomic geochemistry and the Munsell Soil Color system. Replaces generic eco-green cliches with authentic geological chromatics: rich humus loam (#1C1814), raw terracotta (#B65C38), volcanic basalt silt (#262320), and calcified chalk (#FAF7F2). Balances raw agricultural earthiness with clinical laboratory precision to convey unadulterated regenerative soil health.
appropriateUseCases: Regenerative agriculture, organic viticulture, and farm-to-table culinary platforms
Artisanal mineral skincare, clay wellness, and geological wellness apothecaries
Sustainable agronomy tech, soil telemetry diagnostics, and biochar carbon sequestration
High-end artisanal coffee and cacao single-origin terroir showcases
implementationApproach: 1. Munsell Soil Color Tokens: Strict CSS custom property hierarchy based on geological soil horizons: Horizon O (Humus Loam #1C1814), Horizon A (Rich Clay #3B2E24), Horizon B (Terracotta Silt #B65C38), and Horizon C (Basalt Mineral #262320) contrasted against Laboratory Chalk (#FAF7F2). 2. Granulometry Micro-Texture: Subtle SVG feTurbulence filter applied to card backgrounds (frequency 0.85, opacity 0.035) simulating pulverized 200-mesh rock dust powder. 3. Certificate of Analysis (CoA) Data Tiles: Monospace batch telemetry badges ('Batch #8492-VOLCANIC', 'pH 6.8 Balanced', '68 Trace Minerals') using tabular numerals and 0.5px hairline soil-tone borders. 4. Stratigraphic Horizon Dividers: Asymmetrical organic curves separating page sections with layered SVG contours evoking soil depth profiles.
relevantTechnologies: CSS Custom Properties with Munsell Chroma scales
SVG feTurbulence for micro-granular rock dust noise
performanceConsiderations: Uses a tiny 64x64 pre-rendered repeatable SVG noise tile to avoid expensive continuous shader execution while maintaining crisp retinal texture.
accessibilityRequirements: All text combinations strictly maintain a minimum 7:1 contrast ratio against soil-loam backgrounds, verified under WCAG AAA guidelines for editorial reading.
